description: Write files from the design. as "fabrication": the JLCPCB files to <name>-fab/ and a zip (Gerbers, drills, pick-and-place and BOM CSVs, board pictures, a STEP model); call it after a clean check_circuit: a design with errors is refused. "step" or "glb": one 3D model beside the circuit, STEP for mechanical CAD (parts in colour), GLB for a 3D viewer (the board as made); an unfinished design is written too. "html": one offline page for a person (schematic, board, 3D, BOM, files inside). "package": a folder for whoever orders and checks the parts (BOM, datasheets, each library part's verification status). "build": a hole board's build sheet. "easyeda": the board for EasyEDA Standard.

out.description: fabrication: a project folder, e.g. fab; step, glb, html, easyeda: a project file, e.g. cad/board.step

name: export
